say.text: You are Shirkuh's nephew? I was told to look for a young man in his company.
I am Yusuf, the son of Ayyub. Nur ad-Din's letter reached you?
It reached the whole guard. We gave our word, and we are keeping it. The East Gate will not be shut when your banner is at the wall.
We ask one thing of your lord: that the people of the city be safe, whoever wins.
Nur ad-Din does not make war on the people. I will carry your word to him.
Then go quickly, and good fortune go with you.
Nur ad-Din blockaded the city, and the young men of the guard to whom he had written rose and opened the East Gate to him.
